headline: Thomas More's defence holds them clear at the top
dek: Thomas More beat Malone on Saturday for their seventh win of the season, and have conceded eight goals in all matches, both of their defeats coming before conference play opened. Tiffin, who beat Northwood the same afternoon, remain the only other side unbeaten in conference play.
displaced_by: Thomas More's seventh win, at home to Malone; the standing dek's six-win figure no longer held

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are going short at the bottom of the table: Lake Erie's twenty are more than Malone and Walsh have scored between them.

wire.line: Thomas More lead the table alone after Findlay end Lake Erie's unbeaten conference run.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches have gone past their date with no published result; all but Walsh's visit to Pitt-Johnstown are Kentucky Wesleyan's.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tiffin have conceded six goals all season and have lost only once, at home to Charleston on the opening day; since then they have won five and drawn three.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Walsh have conceded twenty-five goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and have won once, drawn once and lost seven times.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nick Cherry has kept five clean sheets for Tiffin.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tom Woodward has scored five goals for Ashland from thirty-eight shots.

last_match.line: Thomas More have still not lost at home this season; Malone's win at Cedarville remains their only conference victory.

next_match.line: Lake Erie's only conference defeat came at Findlay; Cedarville arrive having beaten Northwood and then won at Ashland.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
